cities.name: Phoenix
cities.description: Phoenix is a city in Maricopa County in Arizona. It covers about 518 square miles of land and 1 square mile of water, and about 1,665,481 people live there (Census Bureau estimate for July 1, 2025).

government.summary: The Phoenix City Council is a mayor and eight councilmembers, one for each district, elected on a non-partisan ballot for four-year terms.

city_hall.name: Phoenix City Hall
city_hall.hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, except major holidays

cities.name: Los Angeles
cities.description: Los Angeles is a city in Los Angeles County in southern California. It covers about 471 square miles of land and 31 square miles of water, and about 3,869,089 people live there (Census Bureau estimate for July 1, 2025).

government.summary: Los Angeles has a mayor and a 15-member City Council. Voters elect the mayor, the city attorney, and the controller citywide, and one councilmember in each of 15 districts.

cities.name: Houston
cities.description: Houston is a city in Fort Bend, Harris, Montgomery, and Waller counties in Texas. It covers about 641 square miles of land and 31 square miles of water, and about 2,397,315 people live there (Census Bureau estimate for July 1, 2025).

government.summary: Houston voters elect a mayor, a city controller, and 16 council members every four years. Eleven council members represent districts and five are elected citywide (at-large).

not_listed: The city controller is not listed yet.

schedule.pattern: Tuesdays at 1:30 PM and Wednesdays starting at 9:00 AM. Public comment is on Tuesdays starting at 2:00 PM (5:00 PM on the last Tuesday of the month).
